description: Helper functions and constants for plugin status management, including creating plugin records, hooks, load results, and status reports.

methods.name: createCompatibilityNotice
methods.description: Creates a plugin compatibility notice based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createPluginRecord
methods.description: Generates a plugin record with default and overridden properties.

methods.name: createTypedHook
methods.description: Creates a typed hook object for a plugin.

methods.name: createCustomHook
methods.description: Creates a custom hook object for a plugin with specified events.

methods.name: createPluginLoadResult
methods.description: Constructs a plugin load result object with optional overrides.

methods.name: createPluginStatusReport
methods.description: Generates a plugin status report, optionally overriding default values.
